Apple iPhone 18 Pro Launch Sees High Demand and Consumer Interest in India

Apple's new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max models were launched in India with significant consumer enthusiasm. Reports indicate long queues and overnight camping outside Apple stores in cities like Delhi and Mumbai on launch day. Despite high prices, demand for the new iPhones, particularly in the 'Burgundy' color, remained strong. Celebrities and athletes were also seen purchasing the new devices, sharing their experiences on social media. The sales event saw considerable customer interest, with some outlets noting the continued appetite for Apple products in the Indian market.
